sentences.l2: 当雾霾天气持续加重，气象部门发布预警后，居民应把健康防护放在优先位置。
sentences.l1: When the smog keeps getting worse and the meteorological department has issued a warning, residents should put health protection first.

sentences.l2: 老人、儿童以及呼吸道敏感者应减少不必要的户外活动；外出时，最好佩戴符合标准的口罩，并避开交通繁忙的时段和路段。
sentences.l1: The elderly, children and people with sensitive airways should reduce unnecessary outdoor activities; when going out, it is best to wear a mask that meets the standard and to avoid busy traffic hours and road sections.

sentences.l2: 回到室内后，应及时关闭门窗，开启空气净化器，以持续降低PM2.5浓度。
sentences.l1: After returning indoors, one should promptly close the doors and windows and turn on the air purifier to keep lowering the PM2.5 concentration.

sentences.l2: 选购空气净化器时，不能只关注外观，而应综合考量洁净空气量、滤网寿命、适用面积与噪音水平。
sentences.l1: When choosing an air purifier, one should not focus only on appearance, but should comprehensively consider the clean air delivery rate, filter life, applicable area and noise level.

sentences.l2: 若用于客厅，可选择风量更充足的机型；若放在卧室，则更应重视静音效果。
sentences.l1: If it is for the living room, one can choose a model with a more ample airflow; if it is placed in the bedroom, one should pay even more attention to quietness.

sentences.l2: 此外，定期更换滤芯，并在空气质量好转时适度通风，才能让防护与舒适达到更好的平衡。
sentences.l1: In addition, only by replacing the filter regularly and ventilating moderately when the air quality improves can protection and comfort reach a better balance.
